Generated in the moment of context creation and never changes during context lifetime. 38 */ 39 long getContextId(); 40 41 /** 42 * Context name. Like MAin, Metadata, Script X, etc. 43 */ 44 @NotNull 45 String getContextName(); 46 47 /** 48 * Owner datasource 49 */ 50 @NotNull 51 DBPDataSource getDataSource(); 52 53 @NotNull 54 DBSInstance getOwnerInstance(); 55 56 /** 57 * Checks this context is really connected to remote database. 58 * Usually DBPDataSourceContainer.getDataSource() returns datasource only if datasource is connected. 59 * But in some cases (e.g. connection invalidation) datasource remains disconnected for some period of time. 60 */ 61 boolean isConnected(); 62 63 /** 64 * Opens new session 65 * @param monitor progress monitor 66 * @param purpose context purpose 67 * @param task task description 68 * @return execution context 69 */ 70 @NotNull 71 DBCSession openSession(@NotNull DBRProgressMonitor monitor, @NotNull DBCExecutionPurpose purpose, @NotNull String task); 72 73 /** 74 * Checks whether this context is alive and underlying network connection isn't broken. 75 * Implementation should perform server round-trip. 76 * This function is also used for keep-alive function. 77 * @param monitor monitor 78 * @throws DBException on any network errors 79 */ 80 void checkContextAlive(DBRProgressMonitor monitor) 81 throws DBException; 82 83 /** 84 * Invalidates the context in a span of several phases. 85 *

86 * Each phase represents a different stage of the invalidation process: 87 *

    88 *
  • {@code BEFORE_INVALIDATE} is called before network handlers are invalidated. 89 * In most cases, it will terminate the underlying connection
    • 90 *
  • {@code INVALIDATE} is called after network handlers are invalidated. 91 * In most cases, it will establish the underlying connection
    • 92 *
  • {@code AFTER_INVALIDATE} is called after the context is invalidated.
    • 93 *
94 *

95 * The implementation may choose to ignore some of the phases if they are not applicable. 96 * 97 * @param monitor progress monitor 98 * @param phase invalidation phase 99 * @throws DBException on any error to signal the invalidation was not successful 100 */ 101 void invalidateContext(@NotNull DBRProgressMonitor monitor, @NotNull DBCInvalidatePhase phase) throws DBException; 102 103 /** 104 * Invalidates the context by processing all phases. This method will invalidate just the context. For a "complete" 105 * invalidation involving network handlers invalidation, see {@link org.jkiss.dbeaver.runtime.jobs.InvalidateJob}. 106 * 107 * @see #invalidateContext(DBRProgressMonitor, DBCInvalidatePhase) 108 */ 109 default void invalidateContext(@NotNull DBRProgressMonitor monitor) throws DBException { 110 invalidateContext(monitor, DBCInvalidatePhase.BEFORE_INVALIDATE); 111 invalidateContext(monitor, DBCInvalidatePhase.INVALIDATE); 112 invalidateContext(monitor, DBCInvalidatePhase.AFTER_INVALIDATE); 113 } 114 115 /** 116 * Defaults reader/writer. 117 * @return null if defaults are not supported 118 */ 119 @Nullable 120 DBCExecutionContextDefaults getContextDefaults(); 121 } 122
